items.title: Lackluster Demand Sends Natural Gas Cash Prices Tumbling
items.summary: Physical natural gas prices slumped across the country on Tuesday as weak weather demand further permeated the Lower 48.

items.title: Williams Exec Says $4 Gas Not Needed to Support Haynesville Growth
items.summary: The Haynesville Shale acreage served by Williams’ recently acquired Momentum Midstream platform is poised to bring on substantial volume growth, and at lower breakeven prices than the market might expect, management said.

items.title: Futures Stabilize as Natural Gas Production Swings and Bargain Buying Offset Bearish Weather
items.summary: Natural gas futures recovered modest ground on Tuesday as choppy production readings and bargain buying countered bearish weather forecasts.

items.title: ADNOC Gas Inks TotalEnergies Deal as Global LNG Business Expands
items.summary: An affiliate of Abu Dhabi National Oil Co. (ADNOC) has agreed to supply TotalEnergies with LNG for five years in a deal that expands its relationship with a major US LNG portfolio player and helps build a broader global natural gas business.

items.title: Texas Wind Power Set to Plunge, Putting Natural Gas Generation on Deck

items.title: Woodfibre LNG Advances Permitting Ahead of Canadian Export Growth
items.summary: Woodfibre LNG has applied for an air emissions permit as it prepares to begin commissioning its British Columbia (BC) export facility in mid-2027, when equipment testing and initial gas flows would start adding to Western Canadian natural gas demand.

items.title: Bullish Momentum Proving Elusive for Natural Gas Futures
items.summary: Prompt month natural gas futures inched upward through midday Tuesday, but tepid forecasts and fundamentals limited momentum.

items.title: Natural Gas Bulls Test Breakout, but Bears Refuse to Budge
items.summary: Natural gas futures struggled to sustain Tuesday’s early rebound, retreating from a critical technical threshold after weeks of selling pressure, while increasingly bearish speculative positioning threatened to undermine recovery efforts.

items.title: Pemex Boosts Natural Gas Output, but Infrastructure Limits Supply to Market
items.summary: Mexico’s state oil and gas giant Pemex continued to show improvement in its natural gas output in the third quarter even as flaring continued to be a thorn in the company’s side.
